card.name: Inside Chinese names and place names
card.fires_on: Middle syllables of romanized Chinese personal names and place names, such as the 'ang' in Gu Jiegang or the 'ong' in Shandong. It also fires weakly partway through some drug names such as bupivacaine and pimavanserin.

modes.label: Chinese names
modes.description: A syllable inside a romanized Chinese person or place name, often in a history or news passage.
modes.example: the historian Gu Jieg<<ang>>, and many more.

modes.description: A middle piece of a longer drug name in a label.
